title: Chintamani Library v2.7.5 — Permanent OTA Update Fix & Universal Package Installer Support
releaseNotes: PERMANENT OTA UPDATE FIX: Resolved Android PackageInstaller 'package is invalid' failure by producing 100% clean single-ABI splits and comprehensive multi-architecture universal releases
PACKAGE VISIBILITY ENHANCEMENT: Added explicit package-archive queries in AndroidManifest for seamless intent activity resolution on Android 11+

FILEPROVIDER & MULTI-USER STORAGE: Upgraded APK staging target to external cache storage with prefix URI permissions for flawless installation across all Android OEMs (Xiaomi, Samsung, Realme, Vivo, OnePlus)
UPI PAYMENT GATEWAY OVERHAUL: Dynamic intent construction with automated amount, Prashant Mani Tripathi payee data, and graceful copy/QR fallback
PAYMENT SCREENSHOT UPLOADS: Direct Cloudinary storage for fee payment receipts linked to admin verification requests
DASHBOARD 'PAY VERIFY' QUICK ACCESS: Replaced Record Fee with live Payment Verification card showing real-time pending notification badges
ZERO DEMO DATA: Purged all mock and hardcoded fallback records across notifications, payments, attendance, enquiries, expenses, lockers, and maintenance
WHATSAPP 4D CLAYMORPHIC HUB: Upgraded AutoBot, Broadcast, and Students selectors to multicolour 4D claymorphic cards with zero neon glow
